cases.name: ledger-summary
cases.source:
routine summarize(seed: int) gives int
    var balance: int = seed
    from day = 1 to 7
        if day < 4
            balance += day * 2
        else
            balance -= 1
    give balance
routine main() gives int
    give summarize(34)

cases.name: bitset-population
cases.source:
routine population(bits: int) gives int
    var remaining: int = bits
    var count: int = 0
    while remaining > 0
        count += remaining & 1
        remaining = remaining >> 1
    give count
routine main() gives int
    give population(255) + population(65535) + population(262143)

cases.name: record-ledger-transfer
cases.source:
record Account
    label: text
    balance: int
routine main() gives int
    var original: Account = Account{label: "savings", balance: 40}
    let starting: int = original.balance
    var snapshot: Account = original
    snapshot.balance = snapshot.balance + 2
    if snapshot.label == "savings" and starting == 40
        give snapshot.balance
    give 0

cases.name: utf8-owned-text-pipeline
cases.source:
routine main() gives int
    var document: string = "report".to_string()
    document.append(":ready")
    let contents: text = document.to_text()
    if contents.starts_with("report") and contents.ends_with("ready") and contents.count() == 12
        give 42
    give 0
